extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: Now, what matters most to you — keeping your doctors, or the lowest premium?
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent followed all compliance rules, including delivering the disclaimer before discussing benefits and collecting the Scope of Appointment before scheduling the appointment. The customer was informed about the network and plan details, and the appointment was scheduled for 5 days later.
composition.coaching_note: Great job, Marcus! You adhered to all the necessary compliance steps. One area for improvement is ensuring the customer has a clear understanding of the plan details. Consider asking for confirmation that the customer understands the plan's benefits and costs before moving on to the next step.
